data.description:
## Context / Problem
Agents file bugs outside an epic's hierarchy during epic execution and deem them out-of-scope/pre-existing even when they are defects in the epic's own deliverable; the direct-children close gate cannot see them. Event-precise backtest over 56 analyzable epic closes: 2 real at-close escapes (30a2 token-bin scaling under the token-reduction epic a492; 5b09 artifact persistence under 119f), and legitimate deferrals that must NOT block (30d3 proven-pre-existing fsck diagnostics; e6a0 filed-49s-before-close architectural follow-up, later its own epic; c8ed bug supersedes an investigation epic). 'Open linked bug' alone is not the discriminator — causation is. Incentive risk: the check keys on voluntary links; blocking legitimate deferrals teaches agents to stop linking.

## Approach
Three stages at epic close (verify-completion, epic path only):
1. DET floor: any OPEN/IN_PROGRESS bug with caused_by -> epic or any descendant = deterministic block (like the direct-children gate, completion.py ~:90). Semantically unambiguous; 0 historical FPs; teaches: fix it, re-parent it, or dispute the link.
2. DET candidate filter for the screen: status in {open,in_progress} AND type=bug AND (created after the epic's FIRST in_progress transition OR linked any-relation/any-depth to the epic subtree, both directions). Backtested fan-out: median 3, p90 11, max 24 (upper bounds — snapshot compaction inflates). Commit-relation criterion evaluated and REJECTED: 0 unique catches, 2 FPs, 58% of bug-cited SHAs already unresolvable (Gerrit rebase rot), and comment-hygiene work drains SHA citations from bug bodies going forward.
3. Haiku relevance screen: single-turn per candidate, forced choice {A: describes a defect in something this epic changed/built or behavior its AC claims; B: same subsystem, pre-existing or adjacent; C: unrelated} + one-line citation. Epic material (title/description/AC/children titles) in the system prompt for prompt caching; one warm call then parallel fan-out. MUST ride the model-class config + shared cache settings (bug afeb-bc04: hand-built LLM sub-calls bypass model-class config — do not add another instance; bug 7a79: 4096-token cache floor means small epics may not cache — acceptable, haiku is cheap uncached).
Forward A-verdicts to the completion verifier as compact evidence: title + screen citation + ticket id (~40 tokens each), cap 8 with titles-only overflow count. The verifier's native read-only show_ticket tool (completion.py:8) retrieves detail on demand — no context squeeze, no new plumbing. Verifier directive: block only a defect-in-deliverable with NO recorded disposition; a filed+linked+reasoned deferral (accepted-with-reason, superseded-by, proven-pre-existing) SATISFIES — protecting the linking incentive. Record the full screen tally (per-bug verdict + citation) in the completion sidecar for audit and live FN calibration. Screen failure degrades open (log + skip), never blocks the close by itself; the DET floor is the hard tier. --force-close remains the operator escape hatch.

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/completion.py (DET floor beside the direct-children gate; candidate filter; evidence forwarding)
- new module for the screen (module-size policy: keep completion.py under cap), e.g. src/rebar/llm/epic_bug_screen.py
- src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py (screen tally recording)
- docs/plan-review-gate.md (close-gate section) + docs/llm-framework.md
- tests: unit for filter + floor + forwarding cap; regression fixtures below

## Testing
Regression set from the event-precise backtest — must-block: 30a2-4f2a, 5b09-4f3d (real at-close deliverable defects). Must-pass: 30d3-eaf0 (description proves pre-existence), e6a0-ba9b (disposition trail: filed then superseded by epic 4702), c8ed-d52d (supersedes an investigation epic — investigate/file/close is correct). Documented-unreachable, assert NOT flagged: 5e94-3841 (created 13 days post-close), 22f5-5a48 (fixed during epic, 2h before close). DET floor unit tests: open caused_by bug blocks; closed caused_by bug passes; discovered_from alone does not trip the floor. Filter unit tests: timing window uses FIRST in_progress transition; any-depth link traversal both directions. Screen: fan-out cap, warm-then-parallel ordering, degrade-open on model failure, tally lands in sidecar.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] DET caused_by floor blocks epic close with an open/in_progress caused_by bug in the subtree, with a teaching message (fix / re-parent / dispute link).
- [ ] Candidate filter implements exactly: open|in_progress bugs AND (created-after-first-in_progress OR linked-any-relation-any-depth); commit-relation is NOT implemented.
- [ ] Screen rides model-class config + shared cache settings (no hand-built client), forced-choice output with citation, parallel after cache warm.
- [ ] Verifier receives at most 8 compact candidates (title+citation+id) + overflow count; adjudicates via show_ticket on demand; blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects.
- [ ] Screen tally recorded in the completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open with a logged reason.
- [ ] Full regression set above encoded as tests (must-block, must-pass, not-flagged).
data.title: Epic-close bug gate: DET caused_by floor + filtered haiku relevance screen + verifier adjudication
